about_the_game:
✨ Core Features

🖥️ Total Position & Size Control

  • Precise Placement: Set exact pixel coordinates (X, Y) and dimensions (Width, Height) for any window.

  • Intuitive Sliders: Don't know the exact numbers? Use responsive sliders to adjust on the fly.

  • Quick Resizing: Instantly snap any window to Full Screen or Half Screen with a single click.

  • Proportional Scaling: Resize a window while keeping its original aspect ratio using the size slider.

🎮 Gaming & Streaming Power-Ups

  • True Borderless Fullscreen: Combine the "Hide Caption" and "Full Screen" options to force any windowed application into a seamless, borderless state. Perfect for older games and faster Alt-Tabbing!

  • Cursor Lock (Clip Cursor): Confine your mouse cursor to a specific window. An essential feature for multi-monitor gamers!

  • Always On Top: Pin any window (like a guide, chat app, or video) so it stays on top of your game or primary application.

  • Click-Through Mode: Make a window "transparent" to clicks, allowing you to interact with whatever is behind it. Ideal for overlays and reference images.

🎨 Visual Customization

  • Adjustable Transparency: Make any window semi-transparent to see what's behind it. Great for multitasking.

  • Custom Borders: Add a vibrant, colored border around any application. Customize the thickness and color to highlight the active window or simply for aesthetics.

  • Hide the Title Bar (Hide Caption): Remove the default window caption and borders for a clean, minimalist look.

💾 Save Your Perfect Setups with Profiles

  • One-Click Save: Found the perfect size, position, and settings for an application? Save it as a profile with a custom name.

  • Instant Load: Select a window and load a profile to instantly apply all your saved settings.

  • Unlimited Profiles: Create as many profiles as you need for all your different tasks, games, and applications.

Who is this for?

  • Gamers: Running older titles that don't support modern display modes or need to prevent cursor spill-over on multi-monitor setups.

  • Streamers: Managing chat windows, OBS previews, and other tools on a single screen.

  • Developers & Designers: Organizing IDEs, reference material, and application previews with pixel-perfect precision.

  • Power Users: Anyone who wants to break free from the standard limitations of window management.

Unlock a new level of control and efficiency on your desktop.

name: Fixer Toolkit – Window & Layout Manager

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1 GHz processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / AMD Radeon R3
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Take full control of your windows and games. Resize, move, go borderless or fullscreen, keep on top, add colorful borders, lock your mouse inside the window, and save your perfect layouts.
